segments.contextAfter: Added support for a zero [`total`](applepaypaymentrequest/total.md) in [`ApplePayPaymentRequest`](applepaypaymentrequest.md). In versions of Apple Pay JS prior to version 4, the amount of the total must be greater than zero. Check for version availability using [`supportsVersion`](applepaysession/supportsversion.md) before setting a zero amount.

segments.source: Added support for a zero [`total`](applepaypaymentrequest/total.md) in [`ApplePayPaymentRequest`](applepaypaymentrequest.md).
